author: RIP_Avicus
body:
So, I was reading a thread about how people who make maps should get a gold rank or something, but I thought that this might be a better idea:
Say I made a map, and a game took place on this map, if I wrote something, it would come up like this:
[Map Maker] OscarElNana- Hey everyone! :D

Could this work?
